research_notes: Ownership pass 2026-10-20: Drafted 2026-10-20 by automated research; sources as listed. SBA is an emirate authority organised by Sharjah Law No. (1) of 2019, as amended by Decree-Law No. (2) of 2021 issued by the Ruler. On that basis it is recorded as a public body (state_ownership full; owner and parent the Government of Sharjah). It has no share capital, so no percentage is given. The Gazette text of Law No. 1 of 2019 was not opened. The og.shj.ae pages that surfaced were Decrees No. 11 and No. 15 of 2017 on Sharjah Media City, not SBA. The WAM Arabic pages on the 2021 decree-law showed only site metadata. Sharjah 24's footer names no publisher, so the verifier should confirm it as a Sharjah government outlet or find the Gazette issue. State Media Monitor (June 2026, finder only) says SBA is wholly owned by the Sharjah government and that its predecessor, Sharjah Media Corporation, was created by Emiri Decree No. 25 of 2009. Its claim (MJRC data, May 2024) that government contributions are under half of the operating budget is not recorded. No published amount of state funding was found, so public_funding is empty. Two Sharjah 24 pages on 'SBA' decrees (6 Oct 2022 and 15 May 2023) concern the Sharjah Book Authority, not this body. Earlier pass: Drafted 2026-10-19 by automated research; sources as listed. The decree that established SBA was not found (Sharjah Official Gazette page og.shj.ae opened was Amiri Decree No. 11 of 2017 on Sharjah Media City and does not mention SBA), so legal status, owner and state_ownership are left empty although SBA presents itself as a Sharjah authority. Gulf Today (11 Jul 2024, press) reports an Emiri Decree forming the Sharjah Media Council, chaired by Deputy Ruler Sheikh Sultan bin Ahmed Al Qasimi, with SBA Director-General Mohammed Hassan Khalaf and SBA Director Salem Ali Hamad Al Ghaithi among its members. No sba.net.ae page surfaced in searches. Funding not published.
